author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event signup · April 26, 2024

Japan’s AI market is expanding across healthcare, eldercare, anime, gaming, manufacturing, finance, advertising, and services — changing daily life and addressing social problems. The country hosts nearly 100 Fortune Global 500 firms and 30,000+ companies with century-plus histories. Unique Capital sees Japan’s AI+ industry tech and applications, Chinese firms’ Japan go-global experience, consumer orientation, and craftsmanship culture as worth deep study.

June 23–28, 2024 — Unique Capital’s Japan AI+ Industry Outbound Study Tour: 6 days / 5 nights focused on AI+ healthcare, eldercare, robotics, advertising/media, and data mining, plus Japan landing policy and consumer outlook for Chinese companies.

Four visit themes

  • Artificial intelligence — AI+ mature landings in healthcare, eldercare, robotics, advertising/media, and data mining
  • Cross-border go-global — Chinese success cases and advantages entering Japan
  • Resource links — Japan policy support and resources for Chinese outbound firms
  • Looking ahead — how geopolitics and tech innovation shape China–Japan economic futures

10+ Japanese enterprises & organizations

  • Yunji Technology (云迹科技) — commercial service robots; successful Japan landing; 1,300+ IP filings (800+ patents, invention patents >60%); national/Beijing “specialized & sophisticated little giant,” Beijing Sci-Tech Innovation Top 100, Wu Wenjun AI Technology Invention Award.
  • Meituan — China’s largest local-services platform; Japan travel stack (food, shopping, hotels, attractions, outbound tours) as a window on Japanese consumer potential via local-life internet giants going abroad.
  • Tokyo Fanyou (东京泛游) — game development & publishing; Japan market landing; shares AI in games and Japan go-global lessons.
  • Deepinsight — AI data analysis & mining; visualization tools for enterprise data-driven growth; Japan application and outbound experience.
  • Asia News Agency (亚洲通讯社) — Asia–Pacific media reach; news, publishing, events; AI in Japanese media.
  • Dentsu Group — Japan’s largest ad & communications group (roots 1901 “Japan Advertising” / 1907 “Japan Telegraph & Communications Agency”; renamed 1955); planning, research, media buying, creative, PR; AI in Japanese advertising cases.
  • Tsutaya Books (茑屋书店) — book-centered lifestyle retail (“library in the forest”); cinema, stationery, dining, music, Starbucks; viral cultural-commercial complex often cited for strong monthly revenue without “just selling books.”
  • 7-Eleven Ito Research Center — founded 2012 within Japan’s largest retail group; trains store staff and service quality on Ito-Yokado + Seven-Eleven know-how; brand planning and merchant spirit.
  • Aillis, Inc. — representative Japanese AI medical-device company; AI tools for hospitals/doctors to improve diagnostic accuracy and treatment efficiency.
  • Shonan Robot Care Center — world-class robot care facility; robots for mobility-impaired and special-care populations; AI in eldercare.

One top national university

Visit University of Tokyo and/or Waseda University.

University of Tokyo (est. 1877, Bunkyo, Tokyo) — Japan’s top national comprehensive university; among Asia’s earliest Western-style universities; first among the seven former Imperial Universities.

Waseda University (est. 1882 by former PM Okuma Shigenobu) — leading private university; Top Global University Project Type A; APRU member; world’s first bipedal walking robot developed here in 1969.

Two cultural experiences

Kiyomizu-dera (清水寺) — Kyoto’s oldest temple; National Treasure; UNESCO World Heritage (1994). Otowa Waterfall’s clear spring ranks among Japan’s ten famous springs and gives the temple its name. Program includes Japanese tea ceremony and zazen.

Detailed itinerary & registration

Day-by-day schedule and signup channel were image-only in the original Chinese post (text ends at “Detailed itinerary:”). No registration URL or fee table was extractable — do not invent. Refer to CN article images for the full calendar and signup path.

16 CN tour/partner images; attach on ingest.

— END —
